name: nestjs-cerbos
description: This demo project demonstrates how to use Cerbos in NestJS as an interceptor to validate requests based on policies defined in Cerbos.

paragraphs: This demo shows how to use Cerbos from a NestJS application. A NestJS interceptor asks the Cerbos policy decision point (PDP) whether the current principal may view the document a controller is about to return, and rejects the request when the policy says no.

Cerbos is an open-source authorization layer for decoupled access control. Policies are written in a human-readable YAML format and evaluated by the Cerbos PDP, so your application code only has to ask "can this principal do this action on this resource?".
Cerbos works with any identity provider (Auth0, Okta, FusionAuth, Clerk, WorkOS, or your own directory), because it only needs the principal's ID, roles and attributes.
features: anyone with the admin role can view any document
anyone with the user role can view documents they authored
